concern_summary: This concern focuses on the management of report title fields, including their deletability and the customization of titles for better user experience.
Identification and validation of the title field type within reports, ensuring it is recognized as the correct field type and checking its deletability based on user permissions and report status.
Management and manipulation of the report title, including display, editing, updating based on policies, and ensuring it adheres to user permissions and report status.
This concern highlights the functionalities tied to retrieving and managing the name of a report, ensuring its appropriate display and organization within the application.
Management and tracking of user interactions with the title report field, specifically focusing on the state of report actions related to the reaction list.

This concern encapsulates functionalities related to retrieving, generating, and formatting title report fields as part of an expense report. It includes fetching specific title fields from reports, compiling field lists, and ensuring the title accurately reflects the report's content based on associated policy details.

This concern covers the management and utilization of report names, including retrieving, processing, enhancing, and validating report name parameters. It ensures that report field names meet specified criteria and are correctly handled across user interactions and exporting functionalities.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to validating and setting custom report names, including saving these names as default titles for specific policies, managing their visibility, and handling related states during the update process.

This concern focuses on generating and rendering report names based on user inputs and specific financial actions, ensuring that the created report names accurately represent the data and context of the financial transactions involved.
